reason: The company announced a 1,415 crore capital expenditure plan across four major strategic divisions, signaling aggressive capacity expansion and future revenue growth.
why_now: The official exchange filing was released on September 15, 2026, marking the start of the investment cycle.
source_headlines: UNO Minda Limited: UNO Minda Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 15, 2026, titled "Uno Minda Announces four Major Strategic Expansions Across Multiple Divisions with combined investment of Rs. 1,415 crore.".
